He kept waiting for his attention to be given to him, but nothing came as he stared daggers at them. He just stood there before he saw everyone disperse, now seeing the new neighbor walking to his door. He would quickly duck, not wanting the neighbor to see him staring at him like he was before hearing the doorbell go off, which made him jump slightly.*

***
